title: cure dao
tagline: Cure dao aggregates sensitive medical data from hospitals, encrypts it, and uploads it to filecoin network. Approved universities and research centers will be able to access data for a fee. On-chain access control and encryption are enabled by leveraging the Medusa contract. #FVM
description:
Cure DAOs mission is to help universities and research centers find cures for diseases by providing them with the necessary datasets from hospitals without compromising user data privacy.

Cure dao aggregates sensitive medical data from hospitals, encrypts it, and uploads it to filecoin network. Approved universities and research centers will be able to access data for a fee. On-chain access control and encryption are enabled by leveraging the Medusa contract. #FVM
how_its_made: This project is built using Next.js for the front-end website. From the website home page, hospitals can upload sensitive documents to the Filecoin network by calling the CureDAO FVM agent.. Ethers.js library is used to call the FVM agent which is written in Solidity language. The FVM agent internally calls the Medusa contract to encrypt the document and enable on-chain decentralized access control. Access to the data is provided to approved wallet addresses for a specified fee. The fees generated are transferred to a multi-sig CureDAO treasury wallet. Hardhat is used for the developer ecosystem to test and deploy the FVM agent to the wallaby test network.
